title: Document intake pipeline
tagline: Invoices, claims and forms become validated records. Exceptions reach a person with the reason attached.
summary: Incoming documents are parsed, extracted to a typed schema, validated against master data and business rules, and posted to the system of record exactly once. Anything that fails validation goes to an exception queue with the failing field and evidence.
customer_job: Turn a stream of supplier invoices or claim forms into correct records without manual keying.
baseline: Clerks key fields from PDFs and email attachments; errors surface weeks later in reconciliation.
accepted_result: A record posted to the system of record that matches the document and passes every validation rule, or an exception a clerk clears in under two minutes.

primary_metric.name: Straight-through rate at target accuracy
primary_metric.definition: Documents posted without human touch whose key fields match a sampled human check, divided by documents received.

economics.basis: Illustrative assumption for an accounts-payable team; acceptance is the straight-through share, measured in a pilot.

components.label: Upload portal and inbox
components.detail: Accepts PDF, image and email; returns a receipt ID.

components.label: Landing bucket
components.detail: Immutable original, content hash as key.

components.label: Intake queue
components.detail: One message per document; dead-letter after 3 attempts.

components.label: Extraction workflow
components.detail: Durable steps: parse, extract, validate, decide, post.
components.failure_mode: Step retried after a partial post.

components.label: Layout and OCR parser
components.detail: Text, tables and coordinates per page.

components.label: Extraction model
components.detail: Structured output against the document schema, with page coordinates per field.

components.label: Validation and master data
components.detail: Supplier lookup, VAT check, PO match, arithmetic.

components.label: Case and field ledger
components.detail: Every field, its source coordinates, confidence and rule results.

components.label: Exception console
components.detail: Shows the failing field beside the document region.

components.label: ERP or claims system
components.detail: Receives posts with an idempotency key.

components.label: Pipeline telemetry
components.detail: Throughput, queue age, cost per document.

journey.title: Receive and keep the original
journey.narration: The original is stored once under its content hash, so a re-sent invoice cannot create a second case.

journey.title: Parse the layout
journey.narration: A durable run starts per document. The parser returns text, tables and page coordinates.

journey.title: Extract to a schema
journey.narration: The model returns each field with the page region it came from. A field without a region is treated as missing.

journey.title: Validate against the business
journey.narration: Supplier, VAT, purchase order and arithmetic checks run as code. The model never decides whether a total is correct.

journey.title: Post once, or ask a person
journey.narration: Clean documents post with an idempotency key. An exception opens with the failing field beside the document region; the correction resumes the same run.

journey.title: Measure per supplier layout
journey.narration: Labelled documents replay per release; accuracy is reported per field and per supplier, not as one average.

gcp.headline: Workflows, Document AI and Gemini structured output
gcp.notes: Eventarc starts a Workflows run per object; Document AI parses layout, Gemini 3.8 Flash extracts to a JSON schema, validation runs on Cloud Run.
gcp.rationale: Mature document parsing and regional controls; several managed services to operate.

vercel.headline: Blob, Queues and Workflow with vision extraction via AI Gateway
vercel.notes: Vision-capable models read the PDF directly; Workflow gives durable steps and a resumable human correction. Queues was beta at last check.
vercel.rationale: Quick to build; no dedicated layout parser, so cost per page depends on vision tokens.

cloudflare.headline: R2 events, Queues and Workflows with AI Gateway
cloudflare.notes: R2 event notifications feed Queues, which start a Workflow per document. Extraction can call vendor vision models through AI Gateway.
cloudflare.rationale: Low unit cost and durable steps; layout parsing quality must be measured on the customer's documents.

aws.headline: Step Functions, Textract and Claude on Bedrock
aws.notes: A common production shape: EventBridge starts Step Functions; Textract returns layout, Claude extracts to schema, DynamoDB holds the ledger.
aws.rationale: Well-trodden services with strong controls; more IAM wiring.

azure.headline: Durable Functions with Document Intelligence and Foundry Models
azure.notes: Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice models give a strong baseline before any generative extraction.
azure.rationale: Prebuilt models shorten the path for common documents.

railway.headline: Worker service with a Redis queue and a direct vision model
railway.notes: Simple to reason about; durable step state, retries and idempotency live in Postgres and code.
railway.rationale: Full control, all reliability engineering in-house.
